text: Apples and oranges are sweet fruits. Eating fruit every day is healthy. Fresh fruit and juice are good for your health.
Elephants are the largest land animals. Wildlife in Africa includes elephants, lions, and zebras. The animal kingdom is fascinating.
The bookstore sells books of all kinds. Customers come to shop for novels, textbooks, and magazines. Books and reading are important for knowledge.
Modern buildings have innovative architecture. Office buildings in the city are tall and impressive. Architecture and design shape the urban environment.
Newspapers report the latest news. Media outlets cover politics, sports, and culture. The press informs people about current events.
